description.zh:
AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群的集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.
The region ID of the cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-attribute --db-cluster-id am-bp111m2cfrdl10000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
